CMAJOR: The major key with C as its tonic, and no sharps or flats, having the notes C, D, E, F, G, A, and B.
CMAS: Acronym of Confédération Mondiale des Activités Subaquatiques (“World Underwater Federation”).
CMBR: Initialism of cosmic microwave background radiation.
CMINOR: a minor key with the notes C, D, E♭, F, G, A♭, B♭/B
CMS: Initialism of Chicago Manual of Style.
CMYK: Initialism of cyan, magenta, yellow, key: the colour model used in colour printing.
